study.title: Weed–Crop Segmentation in Drone Images with a Novel Encoder–Decoder Framework Enhanced via Attention Modules
study.short_title: Dense-Inception + ASPP + Attention Decoder for Weed-Crop Segmentation

models_tested: Proposed (Dense-Inception encoder + ASPP + deconv decoder with channel/spatial attention)
segmentation.best_model: Proposed framework (DenseInception + ASPP dilation (2,4,8,16) + CnSAU attention decoder)

dataset.name: Rice-weed benchmark dataset (Huang et al.), Zengcheng Teaching and Research Base, South China Agricultural University
dataset.note: DJI GS PRO UAV at 6 m altitude, 12 MP 1-inch CMOS camera, 4000x3000 original images, spatial resolution ~0.3 cm; tiled to 1000x1000 (12 per image) -> 1092 tiles total, 892 train / 200 test; classes: rice crop, weeds, others.

segmentation.backbone: Dense-inception network + Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (dilation 2,4,8,16)

mIoU.quote: the model achieves an impressive performance of a 0.81 mIoU score across the whole dataset (test images)
mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU 0.81 on the test set (Table 2, Proposed row). Per-class IoU: rice 0.81, weeds 0.79, others 0.84. Ablation best (M5: DenseInception + ASPP + channel(avg)+spatial attention) also 0.81.

mPA.ambiguity: Only IoU (Jaccard) and Precision-Recall curves reported.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed class reported as IoU 0.79 (not F1); shown via Precision-Recall curves.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Rice crop class reported as IoU 0.81 (not F1).

issues: Only base (no seed/ensemble) single-run results reported; no error bars.
